verdict.rationale: Microsoft Copilot is itself an AI assistant/agent, with documented agentic features such as Browse with Copilot and Cowork, so it fills the MCP client role rather than serving tools to other agents. The pack has no evidence that Copilot runs as an MCP server, such as a serve mode or a first-party hosted MCP endpoint. Its connectors to OneDrive, Outlook and Google services are client-side integrations and do not make this server axis apply.
